title: Lift algebra operations and compatible adjoints, without affine quotient sections
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated and finite type. Write $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ and $j_n:X_n\to X$. Let $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ be the canonical transition immersion, specified by both pullback projection equations. Let $c_n:i_n^*j_{n+1}^*\cong j_n^*$ be the canonical composition comparison of tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $p_n:Y_n\to X_n$ be finite, with $g_n:Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ giving cartesian transition squares and $j_{n+1}\circ p_{n+1}\circ g_n=j_n\circ p_n$. Let $G$ be a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent] on $X$ with support proper over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and suppose isomorphisms $\psi_n:j_n^*G\cong p_{n,*}\mathcal O_{Y_n}$ commute with $c_n$ and the canonical affine base-change maps followed by the structure-sheaf pullback maps [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-base-change]. Then there exist an algebra sheaf B [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], an explicit underlying-module isomorphism e:B.toModule ≅ G, and algebra maps b_n:B -> (j_n p_n)_* O_Yn. On each open U and each x in B(U), b_n(U)(x) is the composite of the tensor-pullback adjunction unit at B.toModule, j_n^*(e.hom), psi_n.hom, and the canonical pushforward-composition comparison. These b_n commute with g_n on every open. There is no affine quotient-ring assertion.

proof.text: Choose a proper closed subscheme annihilating G. Its ideal also annihilates the tensor square and cube and the structure sheaf quotient; quasi-coherence and the finite-type affine criterion make these coherent.

Tensor pullback and its canonical comparison commute with multiplication, unit and the monoidal constraints. Conjugate the canonical finite direct-image multiplications by psi; the displayed compatibility equation makes the family compatible.

Use full faithfulness of Grothendieck existence on the tensor square and the supporting structure-sheaf quotient to lift multiplication and unit uniquely. Faithfulness on the tensor cube, square and G checks associativity, commutativity and both unit identities. Equip the additive sheaf of G with these operations, yielding a commutative ring sheaf and its structure map. Its underlying module is isomorphic to G.

Take the adjoints of the transported psi as the algebra maps b. The multiplication and unit comparisons make them ring maps. The adjunction unit and pushforward-composition comparison give their displayed section formula; apply adjunction to hpsi, using hc, to obtain transition compatibility on every open. No quotient-section assertion is included in this step.

theorem finite_structure_algebra_operations_lift
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
      pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I :=
      I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (c : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c n = (Classical.choice (Scheme.Modules.nonempty_tensorPullbackComp (i n)
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 +
      1)))))))).symm ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (hi n)))
    (Yn : ℕ → Scheme.{u})
    (fnY : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    [∀ n, IsFinite (fnY n)]
    (gn : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ Yn (n + 1))
    (hcart : ∀ n, IsPullback (fnY n) (gn n) (i n) (fnY (n + 1)))
    (hw : ∀ n, gn n ≫ (fnY (n + 1) ≫ pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) =
      fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (hproper : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f G)
    (ψ : ∀ n, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn n).ringCatSheaf))
    (hψ : ∀ n,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map (ψ (n + 1)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (fnY (n + 1)) (fnY n) (i n) (gn n)
          (hcart n).flip.w (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn (n + 1)).ringCatSheaf) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).map
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (gn n))) =
        (c n).hom.app G ≫ (ψ n).hom) :
    ∃ B : X.CommAlgebraSheaf, ∃ e : B.toModule ≅ G,
      ∃ b : ∀ n, B ⟶ 𝒪⁎(fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))),
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (x : B.right.obj.obj (op U)),
          ((b n).right.hom.app (op U)).hom x =
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (fnY n) (pullback.fst f
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).hom.app
              (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn n).ringCatSheaf)).app U
                (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f
                    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).map
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
                    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).map
                      e.hom ≫ (ψ n).hom)).app U
                  (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                    (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))).unit.app B.toModule).app U x))) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens),
          (b (n + 1)).right.hom.app (op U) ≫
            (gn n).appLE ((fnY (n + 1) ≫ pullback.fst f
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
              ((fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
              (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hw n]) =
            (b n).right.hom.app (op U))
